text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Since I'm undersized and races are hard on me, Trainer works hard and conducts research for my sake every day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer's gone through every resource available, and has even asked Agnes Tachyon for help.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It makes me really happy, and gives me the motivation to work harder too.
